tree.heading: Administrator
tree.text: The term “Administrator” means the Administrator appointed by the Director under section 1531(c) of this title.

tree.heading: Advisory Commission
tree.text: The term “Advisory Commission” means the Advisory Commission established under section 1541 1 of this title.

tree.heading: Community
tree.text: The term “community” shall have the meaning provided that term by the Administrator, in consultation with the Advisory Commission.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the Office of National Drug Control Policy.

tree.heading: Eligible coalition
tree.text: The term “eligible coalition” means a coalition that meets the applicable criteria under section 1532(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Grant recipient
tree.text: The term “grant recipient” means the recipient of a grant award under section 1532 of this title.

tree.heading: Nonprofit organization
tree.text: The term “nonprofit organization” means an organization described under section 501(c)(3) of title 26 that is exempt from taxation under section 501(a) of title 26.

tree.heading: Program
tree.text: The term “Program” means the program established under section 1531(a) of this title.

tree.heading: Substance use and misuse
tree.text: The term “substance use and misuse” means—

children.text: the illegal use or misuse of drugs, including substances for which a listing is effect 2 under any of schedules I through V under section 812 of this title;
the misuse of inhalants or over-the-counter drugs; or
the use of alcohol, tobacco, or other related product as such use is prohibited by State or local law.

tree.heading: Youth
tree.text: The term “youth” shall have the meaning provided that term by the Administrator, in consultation with the Advisory Commission.
